author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: मया वक्ष्यमाणोपायस्तु प्रामाणिक इति तत्र तत्र व्यक्तीभविष्यतीति भावः
translation: V. The teaching........true conclusion : i.e., the teaching which inculcates certain knowledge of things conclusively. known to be real by means of accurate authorities. This teaching points to but one course here, whether it is of the world or of the Vedas; and no conflict of opinions exists, with regard to it. Such a course alone enables one to practise the duties delighting the Lord.
